headline.zh: 本地部署AI基础设施配置演练

scenario.zh: 某区域银行需要在本地环境部署AI模型处理贷款审批文档,确保客户数据不离开内网
scenario.en: A regional bank needs to deploy AI models on-premises to process loan documents while keeping customer data within their network

instruction.zh: 根据银行现有基础设施选择合适的部署方案
instruction.en: Select the appropriate deployment based on the bank's existing infrastructure

output.zh: 配置完成:8核CPU、64GB内存、2TB存储,适合日均处理500份文档的分支机构
output.en: Configured: 8-core CPU, 64GB RAM, 2TB storage, suitable for branch offices processing around 500 documents daily

output.zh: 配置完成:3节点集群、192GB总内存、6TB存储,支持总行级别高并发文档处理需求
output.en: Configured: 3-node cluster, 192GB total RAM, 6TB storage, supports headquarters-level high-concurrency document processing

instruction.zh: 选择适合贷款审批场景的模型配置方案
instruction.en: Select the model configuration suited for loan approval workflows

output.zh: 已加载OCR+实体抽取模型,可识别身份证、收入证明等结构化字段,推理延迟较低
output.en: Loaded OCR + entity extraction model, recognizes ID cards and income statements with structured fields, lower inference latency

output.zh: 已加载70亿参数通用模型,可处理复杂业务逻辑和非结构化文本,推理延迟较高但理解能力更强
output.en: Loaded 7B-parameter general model, handles complex business logic and unstructured text with higher latency but stronger comprehension

instruction.zh: 对比两种配置的数据安全特性,确认符合监管要求
instruction.en: Compare data security characteristics of both configurations to ensure regulatory compliance

output.zh: 所有推理在内网完成,无外部调用,无遥测数据上传,满足最严格金融监管要求
output.en: All inference runs within the private network, no external calls, no telemetry upload, meets strictest financial regulations

output.zh: 核心推理在内网,仅模型版本检查通过加密通道连接外部,便于快速获取安全补丁
output.en: Core inference within private network, only version checks via encrypted channel for rapid security patch delivery

instruction.zh: 使用测试文档验证系统功能和合规性
instruction.en: Validate system functionality and compliance using test documents

output.zh: 测试通过:数据未离开指定网段,审计日志完整,模型响应时间符合业务要求
output.en: Tests passed: data remained within designated network segment, audit logs complete, model response time meets business needs

output.zh: 基准测试完成:单文档处理约3秒,批量处理吞吐量适合当前业务负载
output.en: Benchmark complete: ~3 seconds per document, batch throughput suitable for current business load

takeaway.zh: 本地部署AI基础设施让受监管机构在不外传敏感数据的前提下使用先进AI能力
takeaway.en: On-premises AI infrastructure enables regulated institutions to use advanced AI without external data transmission
